items.title: Passport check karo
items.detail: Expiry date dekho. Naam ki spelling har document mein same honi chahiye.

items.title: Marksheets aur transcripts
items.detail: School aur graduation ki marksheets, sab ki scanned copies ek folder mein rakho.

items.title: Test scores
items.detail: IELTS, TOEFL, PTE ya GRE, jo bhi diya hai, uska score report save karo.

items.title: Updated CV
items.detail: Projects, internships aur achievements. Ek page, saaf aur simple.
